title: Opening
body:
<<img, "samples/visual-novel-hidden-object/assets/images/office_interior_nophone.png">>
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Secretary>>
You're late. Again.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The city kept me up.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
The city doesn't pay rent. The landlord came by twice.
<<speaker, Detective>>
How much do we have?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Enough for the phone bill or the light bill. Pick one.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Keep the phone. I can work in the dark.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Good. Because the phone rang at eight. Vivian Ash.
<<speaker, Detective>>
The Vivian Ash? Hill money?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Someone stole her gem last night. The Crimson Heart. She wants us on it today.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Why us?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
She asked for someone discreet. I think she meant cheap.
One more thing. Somebody was in here last night. The drawers were open when I came in.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Anything missing?
<<speaker, Secretary>>
Nothing missing. But there are things in here that aren't ours. Have a look.
<<character, hide, detective>>
<<character, hide, secretary>>
<<search>>

title: clueMatchbook
body:
<<speaker, Detective>>
Mae's. Somebody needed light in here and didn't want the lamp on.
<<search>>

title: cluePhoto
body:
<<speaker, Detective>>
A bank notice on a rich woman's door. That's a rich woman with a problem.
<<search>>

title: clueKey
body:
<<speaker, Detective>>
Not my key. Not my coat pocket's usual company either.
<<search>>

title: clueTicket
body:
<<speaker, Detective>>
Yesterday morning. Funny time to pawn a gem that was stolen last night.
<<search>>

title: clueCard
body:
<<speaker, Detective>>
Jimmy leaves these everywhere. This time he left one at a break-in.
<<search>>

title: clueBox
body:
<<speaker, Detective>>
A thief takes the stone and leaves the box. Somebody packed this.
<<search>>

title: Closing
body:
<<character, show, detective, x = 280, xScale = -1>>
<<character, show, secretary, x = 680>>
<<speaker, Detective>>
Her box. Her key. A pawn ticket in her name. And Jimmy's card on top.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
So a burglar broke into our office to leave us presents.
<<speaker, Detective>>
Not a burglar. Somebody who wanted these found. Just not on him.
<<speaker, Secretary>>
And Mrs. Ash?
<<speaker, Detective>>
Mrs. Ash wasn't robbed. Get my hat. We're going to Dock Street.
